beliefs: f inserts a 2-char token at position len//2 (floor) for all lengths [E1, E2, E3, E4]
The token is 'I8' when len//2 is even, '8I' when len//2 is odd [E1, E2, E3, E4]
Empty string gives '8I' (special case, since len//2=0 even would give I8) [E1]
Orientation depends only on floor(len//2) parity, not on character content [E3, E4]
For odd lengths the token goes at floor(len/2), not ceil [E4]
notes: E4 showed odd-length strings insert at floor(len/2) with orientation based on floor(len/2) parity; my v3 wrongly used ceil for some. Fixed by using pos=len//2 uniformly and token based on pos parity.
